title: Senior User Acquisition Manager
description:
About us

As one of the top mobility companies in the world, we have been redefining the industry with innovative mobile technologies since 2013, driving us toward becoming a super app. Join us in our mission to combat global injustice.


We are seeking a strategic User Acquisition expert to drive performance-led growth across our mobile ecosystem in LATAM. This role owns the end-to-end paid acquisition strategy, from planning and executing campaigns across major ad networks to scaling what works through rigorous experimentation and optimization. Leveraging deep expertise in mobile attribution, creative testing, and growth channels, you will play a critical role in accelerating sustainable user growth as we continue building our super app across multiple markets.


Please submit your resume in English. Otherwise, your application will be dismissed.



Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute user acquisition strategies across major paid channels (Google, Meta, TikTok, Apple Search Ads, etc.).
  • Manage and optimize large advertising budgets to maximize ROI and maintain strong CAC performance.
  • Partner closely with analytics, product, and creative teams to improve funnel performance and post-install metrics.
  • Own and scale creative testing pipelines, expanding top-performing assets while ensuring brand consistency.
  • Evaluate and pilot new user acquisition channels, technologies, and measurement frameworks to improve efficiency and scale.
  • Lead and scale digital growth initiatives across multiple user acquisition channels and markets.
  • Build, manage, and optimize performance marketing campaigns to drive sustainable, data-driven user growth.
  • Own large paid media budgets, ensuring strong ROI and CAC through continuous experimentation and optimization.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in user acquisition or performance marketing, preferably for mobile products.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Deep understanding of MMPs (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular) and attribution models (CTIT, re-attribution, SRNs, etc.).
  • Proven experience managing large paid budgets and optimizing campaigns toward ROI/CAC goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to build hypotheses, run experiments, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
  • Solid understanding of creative testing, audience segmentation, and conversion rate optimization.


We offer:

  • Competitive compensation package including comprehensive medical insurance coverage.
  • Meal allowance
  • Embrace the opportunity to make an impact in a pivotal branch within the region, tackling significant security challenges while unlocking great potential for growth and impact.
  • Dental Insurance
  • Opportunity for advancement and upward mobility within the organization, allowing for increased levels of responsibility and growth within the company

Responsible for the technical management of selected customers’ accounts. Define and agree the strategy and tactical plans to achieve the target and growth of the business. Provide technical solutions based on customer requirements focusing on products, services, software and corelated solutions. Introduce and certify new products in the selected accounts.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Diploma/University: Computer Engineering or Science and similar

Contratação CLT + Hibrido 3x por semana - Santo Amaro SP

title: Analista SR de Retail Media & Performance
description:
SOBRE O GROUPE SEB:

Nosso propósito é facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas, tornando o cotidiano mais agradável ao redor do mundo. É com esse foco que nós do Groupe SEB transformamos há mais de 160 anos as necessidades de nossos consumidores em soluções úteis e inovadoras.

title: Sales & Growth (Junior to Mid-Level)
description:
1. About Sofira


Sofira is building the future of legal services. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work, leveraging our team's 12 years of experience processing millions of legal documents.


Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points in legacy systems in Brazil, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.


2. The Opportunity


THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL SALES ROLE.


This is for someone who wants to build a commercial engine from scratch. You won't inherit a pipeline, a playbook, or a team. You will create all of that -- side by side with the founder (Priscila Holanda, CEO) and the co-founder (Pedro Leme, CTO).


You will be Sofira's growth engine. If we don't generate pipeline, we don't grow. And you will be the person who makes that happen every single day.


3. What You'll Do


3.1. Demand Generation (Outbound + Inbound)

  • Research and map target companies: identify who has high volumes of consumer complaints, who spends too much on outside counsel, who is unhappy with their current process
  • Find the right people inside those companies (Head of Legal, Litigation Manager, Director of Legal Operations) using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha, and whatever else works
  • Build and execute multichannel outreach cadences: cold email + LinkedIn + systematic follow-up
  • Schedule qualified meetings for the CEO

3.2. Content Marketing & Social Media

  • Create and publish content on Sofira's LinkedIn and support the founders' personal content
  • Produce posts, carousels, and content that positions Sofira as the authority in legal automation and AI applied to law
  • Monitor engagement, test formats, iterate fast
  • Help build the brand narrative

3.3. Market Intelligence

  • Map competitors, monitor legaltech market movements
  • Research trends in legal automation, AI in law, and legal ops
  • Feed the team with insights that inform product and positioning

3.4. Sales Operations

  • Keep Pipedrive flawless: every contact, every interaction, every status updated
  • Prepare pre-meeting briefings for the CEO ("Company X has Y cases/month, contact is Z, came from channel W")
  • Support preparation of sales materials: decks, one-pagers, case studies, proposals
  • Organize participation in events, webinars, and industry communities (AB2L, legaltech events)

3.5. Whatever Else is Needed

This is an early stage startup. Some weeks you'll help put together a data room for investors. Or research a potential partner. Or organize an event. If you're the type who says "that's not my job," this role is not for you.


4. Who You Are


  • Born hunter:  You wake up thinking about how to reach the next person. Rejection doesn't shake you, it fuels you. You send the fifth follow-up without hesitation.
  • Obsessively organized:  Your CRM is impeccable. You don't lose leads, don't forget follow-ups, don't leave contacts untagged.
  • Hacker mindset:  You don't just do the work -- you figure out the best way to do it first. Before writing a cold email, you research the best outbound strategies. Before building a cadence, you study what actually converts. If the resource you need doesn't exist, you create it. If the conventional path doesn't work, you invent a new one. You get blood from a stone.
  • Curious about the market:  You want to understand how legal departments work, what hurts them, and why our solution fixes it. You don't need to know law, but you need the hunger to understand the client.
  • AI-first:  You use AI as leverage in your daily work. Lead research with AI, email copy with AI, market analysis with AI. If it can be done with AI, you do it with AI.


5. What You Need

  • You can be in the final year of your undergraduate degree or already graduated (up to 4 years of professional experience).
  • Track record of building things and leading projects -- junior enterprise (empresa junior), AIESEC, side projects, organizations, events. If you've never led or built anything, this role is not for you.
  • Reading comprehension in English (you need to be able to consume content, articles, and reference materials in English to keep learning -- speaking and writing fluency are not required).
  • Comfort with social media and content creation (you don't need to be an expert, but you should enjoy it and want to learn).


6. Nice to Have (Not Required, But Valued)

  • Experience with B2B prospecting, outbound sales, or growth marketing (even if it was an internship, side project, or as part of an empresa junior)
  • Experience in a startup or tech company


7. What You DON'T Need

  • A law degree
  • Years of enterprise sales experience (you'll learn here)
  • Experience with the legal market (we'll teach you the context you need in 1 week)
  • Previous experience with CRM or prospecting tools (you'll pick them up in days if you're smart)


8. Why You'll Love Building Sofira With Us

  • Direct impact:  Every meeting you schedule can become a R$500K+/year client. You see the result of your work in weeks, not years.
  • Build from zero:  You will build the commercial machine. The playbook that works will have your name on it.
  • Fast growth:  This seat has a clear path to Head of Growth or Head of Sales as the company scales. And there's equity tied to performance.
  • Small team, massive impact:  In an early-stage startup, you're not a cog -- you're the engine.
  • Real AI:  This isn't a buzzword. You'll work with the hottest technology in the market applied to a real, multi-billion dollar problem.


9. The Deal


Let's be honest about what this is.


We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We are building something from nothing, and that takes everything we've got. The founders are all-in, and we expect the same from everyone who joins.


In return, this is what's on the table:

  • Equity.  We want everyone who builds Sofira to get rich with us. Prove yourself, and you'll have a real stake in what we're building together.
  • Meteoric growth.  You will learn more in 1 year here than in 5 years anywhere else. The person who builds our commercial engine will grow into a leadership role as the company scales.
  • Front-row seat to a market shift.  Legal services is a $27B+ market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. You'll be part of changing that.


10. This Role is NOT For You If:

  • You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day
  • You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes
  • You're uncomfortable with rapid changes or aggressive targets
  • You want a fancy title more than you want to build something real


11. Details

  • Model:  PJ (Independent Contractor)
  • Format:  Hybrid (Sao Paulo)

title: Business Development Manager, Brazil
description:
About ASTERRA


ASTERRA is the global leader in satellite-based infrastructure intelligence. The company utilizes L-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data and proprietary algorithms to detect soil moisture and underground leaks. This technology empowers water utilities, government agencies, and infrastructure sectors- including roads, railways, dams, and levees- to make data-driven decisions.

Brazil is a Level 1 Platinum Territory and represents one of ASTERRA’s most strategic markets within LATAM. The Brazilian water and wastewater sector presents significant opportunities for infrastructure monitoring and leak detection solutions, making the territory a key growth engine for the company.


About the Job


ASTERRA is seeking a Business Development Manager for Brazil to lead and expand the company’s commercial presence in the Brazilian market.

In this role, you will own the development of ASTERRA’s partner ecosystem and market strategy across Brazil. You will work closely with resellers, integrators, consulting firms, and key infrastructure stakeholders to drive new business opportunities and expand existing accounts.


This is a field-oriented role combining strategic leadership with hands-on operational execution . The role requires building strong relationships with partners and water utilities, managing complex sales cycles, supporting project implementation, and ensuring successful delivery and results for customers. The position requires strong autonomy, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in Israel and internationally.


Key Responsibilities


Territory Strategy & Ecosystem Development


  • Define and execute the Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy for Brazil .
  • Map and analyze the Brazilian infrastructure and water utility ecosystem to identify and recruit strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with resellers, system integrators, consulting firms, and service providers operating in the water and infrastructure sectors.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable growth plans to win new customers and expand existing accounts.


Commercial Leadership & Sales Execution


  • Lead discovery meetings, opportunity development, and commercial negotiations with partners and end customers.
  • Build executive-level relationships with key stakeholders within water utilities, infrastructure operators, and partner organizations.
  • Drive collaborative co-selling activities with partners while coordinating internal resources to support deal progression.
  • Develop and maintain a strong partner-generated sales pipeline aligned with territory revenue goals.


Partner Enablement & Ecosystem Management


  • Support partner onboarding, commercial enablement, and product training.
  • Ensure partners understand ASTERRA’s technology, value proposition, and use cases.
  • Monitor partner activity and performance, focusing on strengthening relationships with high-performing partners while optimizing the partner portfolio.
  • Provide training and knowledge-sharing to partners, customers, and ecosystem stakeholders.


Project Oversight & Value Realization


  • Maintain a hands-on approach to project execution, supporting customers and partners throughout project delivery and implementation.
  • Monitor project performance, results, and customer outcomes to ensure successful adoption of ASTERRA’s solutions.
  • Work proactively with partners and customers to improve results, align expectations, and identify opportunities for expansion.
  • Maintain strong post-sale engagement to support upselling and long-term customer relationships.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations teams to align global resources with local market opportunities.
  • Share field insights and market intelligence to support product development and strategic planning.
  • Maintain effective communication with international teams while operating remotely across time zones.


What You’ll Need


Experience


  • 5-7+ years of experience in Channel Sales, Business Development, or Commercial roles .
  • Direct experience in the water, wastewater, utilities, or infrastructure sectors in Brazil is required .
  • Strong knowledge of the Brazilian water and wastewater market and familiarity with public water utilities.


Network & Market Knowledge


  • Existing professional network within water utilities, infrastructure operators, government agencies, or related sectors is highly desirable.


Territory Management


  • Proven experience managing a field territory in Brazil and driving commercial growth through partners and direct engagement.


Languages


  • Native or fluent Portuguese and professional English are mandatory.
  • Spanish is an advantage.


Commercial & Strategic Skills


  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders and partners.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate technical solutions into business value.


Remote Collaboration


  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaboration with international teams, particularly with colleagues based in Israel.


Travel


  • Willingness to travel across Brazil as required.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


  • Revenue: Achievement of quarterly and annual revenue targets generated through partners and direct sales.
  • Pipeline Health: Development and maintenance of strong pipeline coverage within the territory.
  • Partner Development: Growth in the number of active and productive partners in Brazil.
  • Retention & Expansion: Customer retention and expansion through upselling and cross-selling opportunities.


Why Join us?


  • Impact : Work with breakthrough satellite-based SAR technology that helps conserve critical resources and protect infrastructure worldwide.
  • Ownership Culture : Join a high-performance organization built on accountability, collaboration, and customer obsession.
  • Strategic Market : Lead ASTERRA’ s expansion in one of the company’s most important global markets.
  • Growth Opportunity : Be part of a scaling technology company turning advanced satellite data into real-world impact.
  • Compensation : Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives.


*Please ensure that your resume is submitted in English.

title: Especialista Pl. em Vendas de Serviços Digitais (Carros Conectados)
description:

  • Desenvolver business cases, atuando fortemente com a área financeira para análises de viabilidade de novos produtos conectados;
  • Adaptar iniciativas globais ao contexto brasileiro e da América Latina;
  • Trabalhar junto à área de TI (que executa tecnicamente) para viabilização das iniciativas comerciais;
  • Monitorar KPIs de receita, penetração, churn e rentabilidade.


Se interessou? Os requisitos para concorrer à vaga são:

  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Sistemas de Informação;
  • Inglês avançado/fluente;
  • Experiência prévia em carro conectado / telemetria / serviços digitais automotivos dentro de outra montadora;
  • Entendimento de arquitetura básica de carro conectado (TCU, ECU, APIs, backend, data lake — em nível conceitual);
  • Entendimento de plataformas digitais, APIs, marketplaces;
  • Vivência comprovada em monetização de serviços conectados;
  • Negociação e estruturação de parcerias B2B;
  • Interface com matriz/global teams;
  • Estruturação de modelos de receita recorrente (subscription, pay-per-use, revenue share);
  • Desenvolvimento de business cases.


Diferenciais relevantes:

  • Espanhol avançado;
  • LGPD aplicada a dados de mobilidade;
  • Experiência em estruturação de ofertas para frotas, locadoras e/ou seguradoras;
  • Participação em lançamento de serviços conectados no Brasil;
  • Experiência internacional ou projetos regionais na América Latina;
  • KPIs de serviços digitais (ARPU, churn, CAC, LTV, penetração);
  • Entendimento de pricing;
  • Gestão de produtos digitais;



Local de trabalho: São Paulo - SP.


A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.


Comprometida com a sustentabilidade, a Hyundai iniciou medidas para liderar uma era de mobilidade mais sustentável eletrificando sua linha de produtos e expandindo seus negócios de hidrogênio para veículos comerciais e dispositivos de utilidade. Além da mobilidade, confiaremos na economia circular para moldar um futuro mais sustentável que beneficiará não apenas a Hyundai como empresa, mas a sociedade como um todo.


A Hyundai Motor Brasil começou suas operações em 2012, introduzindo o modelo único HB20 no mercado local, projetado e desenvolvido especificamente para o país. Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Se você aspira fazer parte de uma equipe líder em inovação na indústria automotiva, venha se juntar a nós na Hyundai e faça parte desta jornada rumo ao sucesso.


Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.


Venha crescer conosco!!!

title: Especialista de Pricing
description:
Como Especialista de Pricing , você atuará como um parceiro estratégico da área comercial, sendo o ponto focal para a definição e execução da estratégia de preços. Sua missão será equilibrar a equação entre competitividade, cobertura de estoque e rentabilidade (margem), garantindo que as campanhas da Privalia sejam atrativas para o consumidor e sustentáveis para o negócio. Você será o guardião das ferramentas de precificação, realizando simulações complexas e testes para otimizar o revenue management .


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Atuar como o guardião da ferramenta de pricing, garantindo a integridade do carregamento de dados e a correta parametrização das regras de negócio;
  • Definir a precificação tática por campanha, estabelecendo faixas de desconto e estruturas de preços (markups/markdowns) alinhadas aos objetivos comerciais;
  • Realizar simulações de margem projetada e monitorar o trade-off entre cobertura de estoque (giro) vs. margem, propondo ajustes para maximizar o resultado final;
  • Desenvolver e sugerir estratégias de alavancagem de vendas, como criação de Bundles (kits), descontos progressivos e incentivos por meio de pagamento;
  • Realizar o mapeamento constante da concorrência e monitoramento de preços, considerando a visão de "preço final" (Preço do produto + Frete) para garantir competitividade real na ponta;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de testes A/B e validação de hipóteses visando a otimização de KPIs críticos do negócio, sintetizando os impactos financeiros em reports gerenciais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação Completa (Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Estatística ou áreas correlatas);
  • Forte conhecimento em matemática financeira e conceitos de varejo/e-commerce (Margem, Markup, GMV, Giro de Estoque, Elasticidade);
  • Domínio avançado de Excel;
  • Domínio em ferramentas de visualização de dados (PowerBI, Tableau) para monitoramento de KPIs;
  • Domínio em SQL;
  • Perfil analítico com foco em resolução de problemas;
  • Inglês ou Espanhol intermediário;
  • Diferencial: Experiência com ferramentas de precificação e noções de programação (Python ou R).


O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído, sem política de dress code e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Gerente Arquitetura Digital
description:

Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.


E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.


E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!

Arquitetura e Padrões Técnicos

  • Criar arquiteturas de referência (blueprints) para acelerar novos projetos.
  • Avaliar tecnologias emergentes e orientar sua adoção de forma sustentável.
  • Garantir consistência técnica entre squads e BUs.
  • Apoiar decisões críticas de arquitetura em projetos estratégicos.

Engenharia e Processos

title: Lifecycle and Events Marketing Coordinator
description:
About Us

Oxford University Press (OUP), a department of the University of Oxford, has supported education and research for more than 500 years. From supporting children learning to read to advancing global research, our mission is to create the highest quality educational and research resources and make them available worldwide.

Our English Language Teaching (ELT) business in Brazil continues to grow, and we are looking for a Lifecycle and Events Marketing Coordinator to join our Brazil Marketing team.


About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity for a customer-focused and well-organised marketing professional to play a central role in coordinating and delivering marketing activity across Brazil.

The purpose of this role is to coordinate and execute Brazil’s marketing plan, ensuring all activities are shaped by local customer needs and contribute to country revenue growth. The role combines marketing planning, events, campaigns, communications, localisation, and customer lifecycle activity, working closely with Sales, Customer Enablement and Operations.

Reporting to the Managing Director, the Lifecycle and Events Marketing Coordinator will ensure that marketing activity is relevant, well-executed and effectively supports customer engagement across the entire lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the annual Brazil marketing planning process, consolidating inputs, timelines and customer insights
  • Deliver high-quality events, campaigns and communications, ensuring strong execution, participation and effective follow-up
  • Manage the localisation and creation of Brazil-relevant marketing materials, adapting global assets and developing local content as needed
  • Provide the Sales team with timely, accurate and Brazil-relevant materials, information and messaging to support customer conversations
  • Apply customer lifecycle principles across acquisition, onboarding, in-life engagement and renewal, creating or adapting communications where required
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment, clear communication and effective execution of marketing activities
  • Track performance, capture learning and continuously improve marketing effectiveness and customer experience
  • Use marketing and sales tools (including Salesforce, HighSpot, Dotdigital, Eventbrite and Google tools) to plan, deliver and evaluate activities


About You

We are looking for a proactive, collaborative professional who combines strong organisational skills with a clear focus on customer needs and high-quality execution.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Strong customer focus and understanding of the needs of schools, educators and institutions in Brazil
  • Experience coordinating and delivering marketing plans, events, campaigns and communications
  • Ability to adapt global marketing assets and create clear, on-brand and locally relevant materials
  • Experience supporting sales teams with timely, accurate and customer-relevant resources
  • Practical understanding of customer lifecycle stages (acquisition, onboarding, in-life, renewal)
  • Comfortable using marketing and sales platforms and tools to plan, deliver and track activity
  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English

Desirable:

  • Knowledge of the Brazilian education and ELT market
  • Experience in B2B and/or education-sector marketing
  • Experience coordinating vendors or event logistics
  • Experience working with global teams or adapting global frameworks to local markets


Why Join Oxford University Press?

At OUPB, you will be part of a purpose-driven organisation with a global mission and local impact. We offer a collaborative environment, opportunities for learning and development, and the chance to shape meaningful marketing activity that supports education across Brazil.

Apply now and help us support learners and educators across Brazil.

title: Consultor SAP HCM TM
description:

At Strada, possibility isn’t just a promise – it’s the foundation of everything we do. We believe in unlocking potential for every colleague, creating a journey of growth, discovery, and impact.


With the support, resources, and opportunities we provide, you’ll build a fulfilling future – working on meaningful projects that span industries and regions, contributing to outcomes that matter.


Strada is a people, payroll, and technology leader simplifying international workforce management. Operating in 180+ countries, we design and deliver people-first solutions powered by cloud-based technology – helping organizations grow and enabling workforces to perform at their best.


Learn more at


About the Role

Strada is looking for a highly skilled Senior SAP Time Consultant with solid experience in SAP Time Management implementation and support. The ideal candidate will lead time-related functional workstreams, provide expert-level guidance to clients, and deliver high‑quality solutions aligned with HR and Payroll processes.

This role requires strong analytical skills, the ability to work closely with global teams (particularly in Europe), and proven experience delivering AMS and project services in complex environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the analysis, design, configuration, and implementation of SAP Time Management (PT) solutions, including schemas, rules, and work schedules.
  • Provide expert support for Time Evaluation , Absence/Attendance Management , Shift Planning , and Interfaces with Payroll .
  • Conduct requirement-gathering workshops with global stakeholders and convert business needs into functional specifications.
  • Perform enhancements, testing (unit, regression, integration), and documentation according to Strada's delivery standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex time evaluation issues and propose optimized solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across SAP HCM, SuccessFactors, and Payroll.
  • Support AMS operations by handling incidents, service requests, and minor enhancements with SLA compliance.
  • Train users and junior consultants; provide guidance on best practices and process improvements.
  • Ensure alignment with Strada’s governance model, delivery framework, and quality methodologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, HR Information Systems, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in SAP Time Management consulting.
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Time Evaluation schemas and PCRs
  • Absence/Attendance configuration
  • Work schedules, public holidays, and time quotas
  • Integrations with Payroll (SAP HCM or EC Payroll)
  • Experience working in international/multicultural delivery teams.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Poruguese and English languages are a must to have.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SuccessFactors Employee Central Time Off or Workforce Software is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of AMS delivery models (ITIL, incident lifecycle management).
  • SAP certification in HCM Time Management is a plus.
  • Experience supporting European time schemas (Spain, Italy, France, UK, etc.) is highly desirable.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with global clients across Europe and the Americas.
  • Flexible work model with team collaboration across time zones.
  • Professional growth within a high-performing SAP and Cloud consulting environment.
  • Competitive compensation and clear career development path.




At Strada, our values guide everything we do:

  • Anticipate Customer Needs – We stay ahead of trends so our customers can grow and succeed.
  • Own the Outcome – We take responsibility for delivering excellence and ensuring things get done right.
  • Challenge Ourselves to Work Smarter – We move faster than the world around us to drive change and accomplish more.
  • Empower Each Other to Solve Problems – We tackle challenges head on, ask tough questions, and collaborate to find the best solutions.
  • Care About Our Work and Our People – We understand that what we do impacts millions, and we have a responsibility to get it right.


Benefits

title: SAO PAULO/BOGOTA - [HYBRID] - L2 SOC Analyst
description:
About the Company:

As the founding entity of RAINBOW PARTNERS, Quanteam is a consulting firm specializing in Banking, Finance, and Financial Services. Guided by our core values of closeness, teamwork, diversity, and excellence, our team of 1,000 expert consultants, representing 35 different nationalities, collaborates across 10 international offices: Paris, Lyon, New York, Montreal, London, Brussels, Geneva, Lisbon, Porto, and Casablanca.


We are currently seeking a seasoned Security Analyst (L2) to support one of our clients, a leading international financial institution headquartered in Montreal.


Role Overview:

As a Senior SOC Analyst embedded within a 24x7 Security Operations Center, you will be at the forefront of identifying, analyzing, and neutralizing sophisticated cyber threats targeting critical business infrastructure. Beyond routine alert handling, this role focuses on in-depth forensic investigation, proactive threat hunting, and the continuous strengthening of the SOC’s detection and response capabilities. The analyst in this position serves as a technical anchor for the team, guiding junior colleagues and actively contributing to the organization’s overall security posture.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Ownership: Take the lead on high-severity and complex security events, including intrusions involving persistent adversaries, multi-stage attack chains, and advanced malicious payloads.
  • Investigation: Conduct thorough technical analysis across SIEM platforms, endpoint telemetry, and network traffic data to reconstruct attack timelines and uncover root causes.
  • Escalation Support: Serve as the primary escalation point for junior analysts, offering technical validation, investigative direction, and remediation guidance.
  • Documentation: Ensure all incidents, findings, and response actions are precisely recorded in case management systems to support operational continuity and post-event reviews.


2. Detection Engineering & Threat Hunting

  • Content Development: Design, tune, and maintain detection logic, correlation rules, and monitoring dashboards within SIEM platforms to maximize coverage and reduce alert noise.
  • Proactive Hunting: Initiate hypothesis-driven threat hunt campaigns using intelligence feeds, behavioral baselines, and knowledge of adversary tactics drawn from recognized attack frameworks.
  • Automation: Develop and maintain scripts and tooling (Python, Bash) to accelerate investigative workflows, automate data enrichment, and streamline repetitive SOC tasks.


3. Cross-functional Collaboration & SOC Development

  • Teamwork: Partner with adjacent teams (infrastructure, cloud, identity management, incident response) during active security events and broader remediation efforts.
  • Lessons Learned: Actively contribute to post-incident retrospectives, generating actionable recommendations to strengthen security controls and refine processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Support tooling upgrades, SOC maturity initiatives, and security projects to keep operational capabilities in step with an evolving threat landscape.


Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in a SOC environment or a comparable senior cybersecurity role.
  • Demonstrated expertise with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, ELK), including the authoring of queries, correlation rules, and custom dashboards.
  • Advanced understanding of security technologies spanning network defense (firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, VPN), endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), and data security solutions.
  • Solid grounding in incident response lifecycle, log analysis techniques, and packet capture (PCAP) examination.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core networking protocols and architectures (OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMTP).
  • Thorough understanding of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures, with practical familiarity with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux environments, including the ability to identify indicators of compromise and abnormal system behavior.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) applied to investigation support and process automation.
  • A proactive, adversarial mindset with a continuous drive toward improved threat detection and defense.


Working conditions:

  • Candidate must be located or willing to relocate to Brazil (São Paulo) or Colombia (Bogotá)
  • Hybrid schedule with 3 days on-site per week
  • Participation in on-call rotations and extended coverage hours required
  • Availability for morning or daytime shifts, including weekend assignments as part of 24/7 operations
  • Fluency in English required

title: COORDENADOR DE MARKETING DIGITAL
description:
RESUMO DA DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO:


O Coordenador de Marketing Digital será responsável por planejar, liderar, executar e supervisionar jornadas omnichannel estratégicas que impulsionem resultados expressivos para os produtos e marcas da empresa, alinhadas às estratégias corporativas e aos objetivos de negócios. Essa posição atuará como elo central entre as diversas áreas da organização para conceber e operacionalizar experiências integradas, centradas no cliente.


O profissional será responsável por desenhar jornadas com visão estratégica, selecionando os canais mais adequados, incorporando soluções inovadoras como Inteligência Artificial para acelerar entregas e ampliar o impacto. Além da dimensão estratégica, atuará como referência em UX (Experiência do Usuário), garantindo que cada ponto de contato com o cliente seja coerente, relevante e de alto valor.


A posição também lidera iniciativas digitais voltadas à expansão de mercado, aumento e ativação da base de clientes, campanhas digitais e aproximação com pacientes, além de realizar a gestão da equipe interna e de provedores.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Planejar e liderar jornadas omnichannel estratégicas junto as Áreas Chaves: Mapear, desenhar e implementar jornadas integradas para clientes, conectando os canais definidos pela companhia de forma coerente e estratégica, selecionando canais mais adequados para cada etapa. Orientar a construção das jornadas com base em dados, comportamento do usuário e objetivos de negócio.


  • Promover a integração estratégica entre áreas: Integrar Marketing, Medical, Força de Vendas, ExCom, TI, Regulatório e HQ para co-criar jornadas robustas e viáveis, garantindo a execução integral e alinhadas às iniciativas omnichannel.


  • Incorporar Inteligência Artificial e inovação na aceleração da transformação digital: Identificar, propor e implementar soluções de IA e automação que potencializem as jornadas do cliente, como personalização em escala, assistentes para a força de vendas, análise preditiva e recomendações inteligentes. Avaliar continuamente o cenário de inovação digital e trazer soluções que antecipem tendências e ampliem a vantagem competitiva da empresa.


  • Coordenar a experiência do usuário (UX) nas jornadas digitais: Aplicar metodologias e princípios de UX no desenho das jornadas e interfaces digitais, garantindo que os pontos de contato com clientes sejam intuitivos, acessíveis e centrados nas necessidades do usuário. Colaborar com HQ, TI e fornecedores para implementar melhorias contínuas nas plataformas e canais digitais com base em pesquisas de usabilidade, testes A/B e feedbacks dos usuários.


  • Liderar iniciativas digitais para expansão de mercado e crescimento da base de clientes: Desenvolver e executar estratégias digitais focadas em aquisição de novos clientes, ativação de base e retenção, com ações direcionadas a médicos, farmacêuticos, pacientes e outros stakeholders. Planejar e coordenar campanhas digitais integradas (mídia paga, SEO, e-mail marketing, whatsapp, marketing de conteúdo e redes sociais) alinhadas às prioridades dos produtos e marcas.


  • Promover a aproximação digital com pacientes: Desenvolver iniciativas e programas digitais que fortaleçam o vínculo entre a empresa, suas marcas e os pacientes, contribuindo para a adesão ao tratamento, educação em saúde e engajamento com os produtos. Garantir que as jornadas do paciente sejam construídas com ética, empatia e conformidade regulatória.


  • Analisar dados e monitorar a performance das jornadas e campanhas: Utilizar ferramentas de analytics, CRM e dashboards para monitorar o desempenho das jornadas e campanhas omnichannel, identificando gargalos, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria. Compartilhar insights periódicos com as áreas chave, orientando a tomada de decisão e o redirecionamento das estratégias.


  • Gerir o orçamento da área digital: Controlar o orçamento anual das iniciativas digitais, priorizando investimentos com base no retorno esperado e no alinhamento estratégico. Assegurar que fornecedores, agências e plataformas entreguem dentro dos parâmetros de custo, prazo e qualidade acordados.


  • Coordenar fornecedores, agências e parceiros digitais: Gerenciar o relacionamento com agências criativas, de mídia, tecnologia e parceiros estratégicos, garantindo qualidade nas entregas, cumprimento de prazos e alinhamento com as estratégias da empresa. Elaborar briefings, acompanhar projetos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e entregas.


  • Elaborar planos de treinamento digital para a força de vendas: Desenvolver materiais e dinâmicas de capacitação para a equipe comercial, promovendo a transformação digital e o uso eficaz das ferramentas e canais digitais disponíveis. Apoiar a área de Treinamento na criação de conteúdos que integrem as jornadas digitais à rotina da força de vendas.


  • Realizar a gestão do Jovem Aprendiz: Supervisionar, orientar e desenvolver o Jovem Aprendiz da área de Marketing Digital, garantindo sua integração às atividades do time, seu aprendizado prático e seu desenvolvimento profissional.


CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS:

Experiência:

  • +5 anos de experiência em Marketing Digital, com atuação comprovada em estratégias omnichannel, jornadas do cliente, iniciativas digitais e campanhas de marketing digital.
  • Experiência prévia com design de jornadas e/ou UX (User Experience), com conhecimento de metodologias centradas no usuário.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação de marketing, CRM e plataformas de gestão de jornadas (ex: Salesforce, Veeva ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência com gestão de fornecedores, agências digitais e parceiros tecnológicos.
  • Desejável: experiência no setor farmacêutico, saúde ou life sciences.


Formação Acadêmica:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação Social, Administração de Empresas, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas.


  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Marketing Digital, UX/CX, Transformação Digital, Gestão de Produto Digital ou áreas afins será um diferencial relevante.


Idioma:


  • Espanhol: Intermediário
  • Inglês Intermediário


Conhecimentos Específicos:


  • Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de analytics (Power BI, Looker Studio ou equivalentes).
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de UX/UI: pesquisa com usuários, wireframes, testes de usabilidade, jornada do usuário.
  • Conhecimento em automação de marketing, segmentação de audiências e personalização em escala.
  • Noções de Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao marketing.
  • Domínio de métricas e KPIs digitais (CAC, LTV, NPS digital, taxa de conversão, engajamento, ROI de campanhas).
  • Pacote Office com PowerPoint e Excel nível intermediário/ avançado.
  • Conhecimento em SEO, SEM, LLMs, marketing de conteúdo e estratégias inbound.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno (Gestão de acesso e Identidade)
description:
Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados do mundo nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com um dos portfólios mais amplos de seguros do mercado, comercializamos nossos produtos através do canal de vendas do banco Santander Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.


Na ZS nos preocupamos em manter um ambiente que contemple a diversidade. São oferecidas oportunidades iguais e todos os candidatos são considerados qualificados para as vagas, sem discriminação por motivos de deficiência, sexo ou orientação sexual, gravidez ou licença-maternidade, raça ou origem nacional ou étnica, idade, religião ou crença, identidade de gênero, estado civil, status de veterano protegido (se aplicável) ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei.


Hoje estamos procurando um Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, aqui é o seu lugar!


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Segurança, Compliance e Gestão de Identidades (IAM) (Gestão de Acessos e Identidade)
  • Implementar controles relacionados à Segurança da Informação e atuar em conjunto com a área de TI para avaliar novos projetos/produtos e recomendar padrões de segurança adequados.
  • Elaborar e implementar controles internos e indicadores de performance (KPIs) para cyber.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de IAM incluindo sistemas de autenticação, autorização e gerenciamento de identidades.
  • Monitorar e analisar atividades de acesso para identificar e mitigar riscos de segurança.
  • Desenvolver e manter políticas e procedimentos.
  • Apoiar em auditorias regulares de acesso e conformidade.
  • Colaborar com equipes de TI e segurança para integrar soluções de IAM com outros sistemas e aplicativos.
  • Fornecer suporte e treinamento aos usuários sobre práticas de segurança e uso de sistemas de IAM.
  • Investigar e responder a incidentes de segurança relacionados a identidades e acessos.
  • Executar criação, modificação e revogação de acessos para usuários internos e externos.
  • Gerenciar contas em sistemas corporativos, Azure AD, sistemas legados e aplicações SaaS.
  • Apoiar campanhas de revisão de acessos (SoD, Revalidação, RBAC).
  • Apoiar no monitoramento de acessos privilegiados (PAM).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança para identidades, onboarding, offboarding e acessos críticos.
  • Identificar acessos inadequados, riscos de permissões excessivas e desvios de conformidade.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de automação para rotinas de IAM (scripts simples em PowerShell).


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Segurança, Compliance e Gestão de Identidades (IAM).
  • Formação Superior completa nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação.
  • Desejável MBA ou Pós graduação em Cyber Security.
  • Experiência em gerenciamento de identidades e acessos.
  • Conhecimento de normas e frameworks de mercado (ISO 27001/02, NIST, CIS, PCI, etc).
  • Conhecimento com protocolos e tecnologias de IAM, como LDAP, SAML, OAuth, e OpenID Connect.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de IAM, como AD, Entra ID, Okta, SailPoint ou similares.
  • Active Directory (AD) — usuários, grupos, OUs.
  • Azure AD / Entra ID — grupos, funções, MFA, SSO.
  • Princípio do menor privilégio.
  • Controle de acessos baseado em função (RBAC).
  • Segregação de funções (SoD).
  • Ciclo de vida de identidades.
  • Acessos privilegiados (noções de PAM).
  • Noções de LGPD aplicadas à gestão de identidades.
  • Inglês e Espanhol básicos é um diferencial


Habilidades e competências:

  • Perfil Analítico.
  • Proativo
  • Habilidade em negociação e comunicação.
  • Orientação para resultados.
  • Forte capacidade de relacionamento.
  • Trabalho em equipe.

title: User Operations Expert
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a User Operations Expert – User Growth to join our Growth team in São Paulo. This role will be responsible for driving end-to-end customer growth strategy , focusing on user acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention .

You will play a critical role in building a scalable and sustainable user growth engine , combining data insights, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration to unlock new growth opportunities and maximize user lifetime value.

Key Responsibilities

1. User Growth Strategy & Execution

  • Design and execute customer growth strategies across the full funnel (acquisition → activation → retention → loyalty)
  • Develop a structured growth framework based on user lifecycle and behavioral insights
  • Build and continuously optimize a sustainable growth engine aligned with business goals

2. User Segmentation & Retention Strategy

  • Develop and manage a robust user segmentation model (e.g., new, active, dormant, high-value users)
  • Design targeted engagement and retention initiatives to increase stickiness and frequency
  • Drive lifecycle marketing strategies to improve user contribution, loyalty, and long-term value

3. Channel Expansion & Acquisition Optimization

  • Identify and test new user acquisition channels (organic, paid, partnerships, referrals, etc.)
  • Optimize channel performance through continuous experimentation and A/B testing
  • Stay ahead of emerging traffic trends and growth tactics to reach high-quality users

4. Data Analysis & Product Collaboration

  • Analyze user behavior data to identify growth opportunities across acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Translate insights into actionable growth initiatives and experiments
  • Partner closely with Product and Tech teams to enhance user experience and product features that drive growth

5. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Data, and Tech teams to align priorities and resources
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to ensure efficient execution of growth projects
  • Act as a key stakeholder in growth-related decision-making and roadmap planning

Requirements

  • Proven experience in User Growth, User Operations, Growth Marketing, or similar roles (preferably in B2C / marketplace / tech environments)
  • Strong understanding of growth frameworks (AARRR, lifecycle management, retention loops)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale user growth strategies from data insights
  • Advanced analytical skills (SQL or strong data analysis capability is a plus )
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive initiatives end-to-end in a fast-paced environment
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese

title: Data Engineer (Azure/Databricks)
description:
We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to design, build, and scale modern data solutions using Azure Databricks. In this role, you will own the end-to-end development of data pipelines, drive best practices in data architecture, and ensure high-quality, reliable data is delivered to support analytics and business decision-making.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Azure Databricks, ensuring alignment with lakehouse architecture and medallion design patterns
  • Design and implement end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from diverse sources, transform it based on business requirements, and deliver it to downstream consumers
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain Apache Spark and PySpark jobs to efficiently process large-scale datasets
  • Implement data quality frameworks, validation processes, and monitoring/alerting systems to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and availability
  • Drive best practices by developing reusable frameworks, libraries, and standardized approaches for data engineering across the team
  • Optimize query performance and resource utilization within Azure environments to ensure cost efficiency and scalability
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of data pipelines, workflows, and architecture while ensuring compliance with security and governance policies
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and promote engineering excellence within the data organization


Need to Haves


  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, including at least 2+ years working with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark
  • Strong programming skills in Python and PySpark, along with advanced SQL (especially Spark SQL)
  • Proven experience building configuration-driven ETL pipelines and orchestrating workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, or Apache Airflow
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling and data vault methodologies
  • Hands-on experience with Delta Lake and lakehouse/medallion architecture patterns
  • Experience with Azure services including Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, REST APIs, SFTP, and Azure Key Vault
  • Proficiency in Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows
  • Experience with CI/CD practices for deploying and managing data pipelines
  • Fluent English to interact with international teams


Nice to Haves


  • Experience working with large-scale distributed data systems and performance optimization techniques
  • Familiarity with data quality, testing, and observability frameworks
  • Experience supporting analytics or data science teams with curated and accessible datasets
  • Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid cloud data environments
  • Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices in cloud platforms

title: Strategic Planning & Consumer Insights Senior Manager LATAM
description:
Job Title: Strategic Planning & Consumer Insights Senior Manager | Samsung Electronics


Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP.
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site


Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !


Job Description

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior Manager to lead our Big Data and Consumer Market Insights (CMI) initiatives, playing a pivotal role in translating complex consumer data into actionable insights that shape business strategy. As a key team member, you’ll analyze consumer behavior, identify trends, and drive data-based decisions, aligning closely with cross-functional teams to enhance the customer journey and address critical business needs. This role is an excellent opportunity for a data leader with strong analytical and communication skills who thrives on influencing business outcomes.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive big data strategy that aligns with business objectives and leverages cutting-edge technologies (cloud platforms, machine learning, AI).
  • Oversee the collection, processing, and analysis of diverse data sources, including consumer interactions, product usage, social media, and market trends.
  • Apply advanced analytics to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that address business challenges and drive innovation.
  • Develop predictive models and algorithms to anticipate consumer behavior and market dynamics.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (product, marketing, sales) to translate data insights into actionable strategies and product roadmaps. By understanding business pain points and develop data-driven solutions that support organizational goals.
  • Communicate complex data findings in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences. And drive the creation and maintenance of dashboards and reporting tools that allow business units to make informed, data-backed decisions.
  • Stay ahead of the curve by exploring and evaluating emerging technologies in big data and analytics (e.g., data lakes, real-time analytics). Utilize advanced data analytics techniques (predictive modeling, machine learning, etc.) to forecast consumer trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Build a thriving Big Data Community across LATAM: Foster a collaborative network of data professionals across Samsung subsidiaries in Latin America. This community will serve as a platform for knowledge sharing, best practice development, and driving a data-driven culture across the region. You will empower these individuals to become evangelists for data-driven decision-making within their respective operations, with a strong focus on achieving measurable business results and contributing to Samsung's overall success in the LATAM market.
  • Design and execute innovative market research studies (surveys, focus groups, customer interviews) to gather qualitative and quantitative data on consumer needs and preferences. And lead data analysis strategies that extract and interpret patterns in consumer data to understand behaviors, needs, and preferences.
  • Analyze market research data to identify key trends, competitive landscape, and opportunities for differentiation. Utilize advanced data analytics techniques (predictive modeling, machine learning, etc.) to forecast consumer trends and identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the consumer electronics market, emerging trends (e.g., IoT, smart home), and Samsung's competitive positioning.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate consumer insights into product development, marketing campaigns, and go-to-market strategies. By identify business pain points and develop data-driven solutions that support organizational goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics or other relevant areas.
  • Experience in a data-driven role, with leadership responsibilities.
  • Deep understanding of business operations and market dynamics, with strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data insights to business objectives, anticipate future trends, and identify opportunities for growth and innovation.
  • A deep understanding of consumer behavior, empathy for customer needs, and a passion for uncovering their motivations and pain points.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Able to convey complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, build consensus, and influence stakeholders.
  • A strong team player with proven ability to build relationships, foster a data-driven culture, and collaborate effectively across departments.
  • Driven to achieve goals, exceed expectations, and deliver impactful results that contribute to Samsung's success. Adept at using data to solve real business problems, with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Strong organizational skills and experience managing multiple projects simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Proven expertise in big data technologies (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), statistical analysis tools (R, Python), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI). Advanced Excel.
  • Advanced English skills, Spanish will be considered a plus.


Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team : Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges : Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future : Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact : Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.


Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Global networking and collaboration



At Samsung, we want you to be yourself! We prioritize fairness and will never request personal information unrelated to the selection process, such as marital status, age, gender, religion, or political opinions.

title: Marketing Coordinator/Specialist
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.


Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.


In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.


About the position:

We are looking for a Marketing Coordinator/Specialist who will be responsible to lead high-impact growth projects with a high degree of autonomy and ownership. This role blends quantitative rigor, qualitative judgment, and creativity in a project-based environment where no two days look the same. It is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes initiative, and wants to grow rapidly by solving meaningful business challenges. You will partner closely with the Marketing Lead on high-priority initiatives and be expected to demonstrate strong leadership, sound judgment, and structured problem-solving.


If you are a driven person who wants to contribute to the gaming industry, we’d love to work with you!


Make sure to share your CV in English.


Exclusivity contract required.


Responsibilities:

  • Growth Strategy: Partner with the Marketing Lead to structure complex business challenges into components, develop and validate hypotheses with data, and shape solutions with justifiable ROI.
  • Project Management: Independently scope, plan, and execute multiple concurrent projects end-to-end, leading cross-functional teams and owning the final outcomes.
  • Performance Analysis: Assess project effectiveness and ROI to inform future decisions, optimize resource allocation, and improve marketing efficiency.
  • Player & Product Insight: Build a deep understanding of the game and players.


Main job requirements:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Candidates from Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or other quantitative disciplines with relevant experience are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience: 3–6 years of experience in marketing, growth, or performance marketing, with a track record of initiating and driving projects end-to-end. Candidates with non-marketing backgrounds and/or fewer than 3 years of experience will be considered, provided strong transferable experience from the following environments (e.g., MBB, BB IB, PE, VC, or high-growth startups).
  • AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and workflows effectively, including AI-enabled automation, agent-based ways of working, etc.
  • Passion for Gaming: Active gamer with a genuine interest in gaming culture and content.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken.
  • Tools: Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, X/VLOOKUP, and structured data handling.
  • Available to work in person at our office in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid mode).

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).


Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.


Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.


How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

  • Proficient English verbal communication skills

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

  • This role requires a deep understanding of retail dynamics, consumer behavior, and the ability to collaborate across functions to deliver impactful results.

  • Developing and executing strategies to enhance brand visibility and reinforce brand awareness in retail partner stores;

  • Ensuring consistent brand representation and messaging across all retail channels.

  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (sales, product management, creative) to ensure seamless execution of marketing plans;
  • Leading, mentoring, and managing a team of promoters and store leaders, ensuring they are well-trained and equipped to represent the brand effectively;
  • Monitoring campaign performance and adjust strategies as needed to achieve desired outcomes;
  • Monitoring and analyzing sales performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement;
  • Working closely with promoters and store leaders to ensure the achievement of sales targets for consumer electronics categories;
  • Providing actionable insights and recommendations to drive sales growth and maximize ROI.
  • Tracking and analyzing key performance metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of retail marketing activities;
  • Preparing detailed reports on team performance, campaign results, and sales achievements for senior management;
  • Providing actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Overseeing the allocation and management of retail marketing budgets to ensure cost-effective solutions;
  • Monitoring expenses and ensuring alignment with financial targets and budget execution.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of retail dynamics, consumer behavior, and market trends.
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and performance measurement tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions.
  • Fluence in English is mandatory.
  • Domain in MS office package to manage big data bases in Excel and presentation creations in Power point.
  • Strong story telling creation and presentation capabilities (in Portuguese and English).

description:

We are seeking a Integrated Marketing Director to lead and scale growth engine in Brazil. This leader will own the full user growth funnel—from acquisition to retention—while building a high-performing team across User Operations, Campaign Marketing .

This role requires a strategic operator who combines data-driven decision-making, strong execution, and team leadership to drive sustainable, scalable growth in a highly competitive market.

title: Mobile QA Engineer
description:
Mobile QA Engineer

Location: LATAM


Looking for a talented and motivated Quality Test Engineer to contribute to the mission of helping the world’s farmers sustainably increase productivity using digital tools, mobile software, advanced analytics and high quality assurance standards. This role is a unique opportunity to join our dynamic Brazil laboratory, responsible for testing the web & mobile apps that will operate under extreme environments and help ensure a great experience for our customers.


You will work on creating Test Plans and Test Cases and in most cases performing the manual testing based on those Test Plans and Test Cases. You will ensure our applications are accurate, robust, scalable, performant and deployable, and will have the opportunity to work with large, "big data" sets such as scientific data, machine generated data from our farmer's equipment to geospatial data, precision agriculture, remote sensing, weather and soil data. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering and business partners to enable a seamless, high-quality experience for our customers.


What You Will Do:

  • Pair up with software engineers, product owners and test engineers to deliver manual test suites to validate our web and mobile (iOS, Android) applications
  • Test our applications with different locales to guarantee a valuable global product experience to our customers, going to the field when necessary
  • Collaborate with scientists and engineers to ensure the data and software tools they use are accurate and reliable
  • Write up test strategies, test plans, design documents, and whatever else may be needed
  • Actively engage in root cause analysis reviews
  • Assist in ongoing process improvement efforts to ensure test planning, execution, and reporting is effective and efficient
  • Create detailed incident reports for production issues, and work on triage and investigation
  • Be willing to take on other responsibilities and tackle a variety of engineering and testing problems - we are a small team and all share role
  • Be willing to be a representative of the QA team on a project and lead all test activities that are needed



Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience designing and developing manual tests for web and mobile (iOS and android) with a stronger emphasis on web experience
  • Strong self-starter who will work closely and daily with an existing team of other self-starters
  • Ability to provide & received direct and regular self improvement feedback with peers
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field.
  • Equivalent work experience may be accepted
  • Nice to have: Agriculture degree with QA knowledge and experience
  • Understanding the SDLC and the tester role and responsibility within it
  • You understand deadlines and the need to deliver the most valuable things first
  • English fluency
  • You will communicate with US based teams on a daily basis and bridge any communication gaps between English and non-English team members
  • at least B2 level of English, Cambridge or similar certification is a Plus
  • Understanding of common user interface design patterns and software quality assurance methodologies
  • Experience working in Agile teams, experience in SAFe is a Plus


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with blackbox testing
  • Strong experience with web
  • Medium experience with mobile and API testing
  • ISTQB certification is a Plus
  • basic programmer knowledge is a Plus


We also hinge our cultural DNA on these five values:

  • Inspire one another
  • Innovate in all we do
  • Leave a mark on the world
  • Find the possible in the impossible
  • Be direct and transparent

title: Analista de TI Pl (SAP)
description:

A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach’s®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.


Analista de TI Pl (SAP)


O Analista de TI Pl com foco em SAP SD e Força de Vendas, contribuindo para a identificação de oportunidades de negócio, proposição de soluções tecnológicas robustas e evolução contínua dos sistemas de Vendas, Marketing, Trade e Merchandising. Suportar as áreas de negócios em implementação de melhorias, integrações e projetos estratégicos, garantindo desempenho, conformidade e eficiência dos processos.


Localidade: São Paulo - SP


Reporta-se ao: Supervisor de Tecnologia da Informação


Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido


Contamos com você para:


  • Avaliar iniciativas das áreas de negócio, traduzindo necessidades em soluções de TI aderentes à estratégia corporativa;
  • Monitorar o mercado e tendências tecnológicas, identificando soluções inovadoras e oportunidades de evolução para o negócio;
  • Manter e evoluir os serviços e sistemas de TI relacionados às áreas de Vendas, Marketing, Trade Marketing e Merchandising, garantindo estabilidade e melhoria contínua;
  • Conduzir levantamento de requisitos, análise funcional e especificação de melhorias em sistemas, assegurando alinhamento entre negócio e tecnologia;

  • Participar da implementação de projetos de TI, desde o planejamento até a entrega, assegurando prazos, qualidade e aderência aos requisitos definidos.


Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:


  • Formação superior completa em áreas de Tecnologia da Informação ou correlatas;
  • Experiência com processos de negócios, envolvendo os assuntos de vendas, preços, descontos, impostos, análise de crédito, faturamento, nota fiscal eletrônica e contabilização;
  • Experiência prévia com ERP SAP SD e integrações com sistemas (EDI, APIs, RFCs);
  • Conhecimentos com Metodologias Ágeis para participar e executar projetos, bem como desenho de fluxos de processos de negócios (BPM);
  • Inglês ao nível avançado, com habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita.


O que nós oferecemos:


Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:


  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Dr Dori (telemedicina)
  • Seguro de vida
  • Totalpass e/ou Wellhub
  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Vale Natal
  • Vale transporte
